reference_period_proposal: 2010-01-01 through 2025-12-31, evaluated per source variable/version and availability
variables: sunshine or solar radiation where available
feature_method: Use month-of-year anomalies/quantiles relative to a versioned historical reference, keep coverage count and uncertainty; do not rank when evidence is unavailable.
overlap_rule: Live weather remains short-horizon operational context. Historical climate/seasonality is a separate reference feature and neither overwrites nor substitutes for the other.
